declared_intent: Produce research-backed writing inside a user-confirmed project folder with clear source handling.

allowed_by_default: Read user-provided briefs, notes, and source documents.
Write drafts, outlines, and revision notes inside the chosen workspace.
Use web research only when the user asks for current or external evidence.
confirmation_required: Creating new writing folders outside the workspace.
Using connector accounts or private documents.
denied_by_default: Inventing citations or copying long copyrighted passages.
Treating Drive or document automation as implied permission.

token_optimization: Move rubrics, examples, style libraries, and review workflows into references.
selection_precision: Distinguish research-writing from Drive automation, document formatting, and generic summarization.
review_status: preview-only; user should review before installation
